llm.summary: This skill does what it claims, but users should know their Lenormand questions may be sent to QiyueAstro's API.

dimensions.detail: Network access to qiyueastro.com is necessary for the stated function, and no local file, credential, or broad environment access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of markdown skill instructions and a README; no executable install hooks, scripts, package installs, or mutation steps were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation conditions, endpoints, formatting rules, language handling, and error behavior are scoped to Lenormand card draws and card/spread lookup.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, credential storage, privilege escalation, or local profile/session access is described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is coherently focused on drawing and browsing Lenormand cards through QiyueAstro's public API; sending a user's reading question is purpose-aligned but privacy-relevant.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should be comfortable with Lenormand draw requests, including any question text they provide, being sent to QiyueAstro's unauthenticated public API. Avoid putting secrets, private identifiers, or highly sensitive personal details in the question.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The artifact does instruct the agent to pass the user's question to the QiyueAstro draw endpoint and says the API echoes it back. This is central to the reading workflow and disclosed in the skill text, so it is not enough for a Review verdict, but users should avoid including highly sensitive or identifying details.
